pages.title: Linux on this phone
pages.purpose: Hub for managing the app's own Ubuntu: Running, Ports, Storage, Packages, Repair and Reset, with the package job on top while one runs.
gates: in-app host only: ThisPhoneScreen shows the row when host.kind == PhoneHostKind.inApp and the host is installed

elements.label: Running
elements.effect: Opens Running.

elements.label: Ports
elements.effect: Opens Ports.

elements.label: Storage
elements.effect: Opens Storage.

elements.label: Packages
elements.effect: Opens Packages.

elements.label: Repair Linux
elements.effect: _repair: refused while setup or a package job runs, then a neutral question; confirming calls onRepair, which re-runs setup checks (PhoneServerAction.update).
gates: not while setup or a package job runs

elements.label: Reset Linux
elements.effect: resetLinux: typed-word question (Reset), removes Linux keeping projects, forgets saved in-app servers, opens phone setup.
gates: not while setup or a package job runs

elements.label: Stop installing / removing / updating
elements.effect: Names the running package job and stops it after a question.
gates: a package job is running

pages.title: Running in Linux
pages.purpose: Programs running inside the app's Linux by kind (OpenCode server, Paseo, agent, dev server, other) with memory and busy or idle, refreshed every 10 seconds; named, confirmed Stop that also stops what the program started.
gates: in-app host only: ThisPhoneScreen shows the row when host.kind == PhoneHostKind.inApp and the host is installed

elements.label: Program row
elements.effect: Opens the details sheet (what it is, facts, command and ids under Details).

elements.label: Stop <program>
elements.effect: _stopFromList: names the program and the helpers that stop with it, then LinuxManager.stop sends exact pid:start-time identities.
gates: not the OpenCode server
disabled while stopping

elements.label: Copy command
elements.effect: Copies the command line (redacted).

elements.label: [pull to refresh]
elements.effect: Reads /proc again.

pages.title: Ports in Linux
pages.purpose: Ports with something listening inside the app's Linux (each proven by a connection), the program that uses it, and Open preview through openDevPreview on the phone's loopback.
gates: in-app host only: ThisPhoneScreen shows the row when host.kind == PhoneHostKind.inApp and the host is installed

elements.label: Port <n> · Open preview
elements.effect: _preview: openDevPreview with DevPreviewLink(port) against the in-app server address; same rules as chat links.
gates: not the OpenCode server or Paseo

elements.label: Stop <program>
elements.effect: _stopOwner: confirmed stop of the program whose command names the port.
gates: an owner is known and is not protected

elements.label: Copy address
elements.effect: Copies http://127.0.0.1:<port>/.

pages.title: Linux storage
pages.purpose: Where the space of the app's Linux goes in six categories, and the safe cleanups (package downloads, Node and download caches, old temporary files and logs, old agent versions) with the space each frees.
gates: in-app host only: ThisPhoneScreen shows the row when host.kind == PhoneHostKind.inApp and the host is installed

elements.label: Clear <what>
elements.effect: _clean: question naming what it clears and the size; LinuxManager.cleanup takes the installer slot, measures before and after and reports the freed space. Only allow-listed paths; never projects or sign-ins.
gates: only cleanups with at least 1 KB to give back
refused while setup or a package job runs

pages.title: Packages
pages.purpose: Installed Ubuntu packages (searchable), install by name, remove with what else would go, and Update system; all long work is the background package job.
gates: in-app host only: ThisPhoneScreen shows the row when host.kind == PhoneHostKind.inApp and the host is installed

elements.label: Install a package
elements.effect: _install: name dialog (validated, checked with apt), then a question, then the linux-job service.
gates: no package job running

elements.label: Update system
elements.effect: _update: question, then the linux-job service runs apt update and upgrade (45 minute budget).
gates: no package job running

elements.label: Package row
elements.effect: Details sheet with Remove.

elements.label: Remove <package>
elements.effect: _remove: asks apt what else would go, refuses when that includes something Linux needs, confirms, then runs the job.
gates: not essential, required or setup-owned packages
no package job running

elements.label: Search installed packages
elements.effect: Filters the installed list by name.

pages.title: Running on this phone
pages.purpose: What the app runs on the phone (in-app Linux), grouped under what started it (left behind, OpenCode, each Claude Code conversation by title, agent helper, AI Team, terminal, setup, helpers, this app) as a parent-child tree, with processor use, memory and run time; heavy and may-be-stuck marks; a warning from 28 processes; a named, confirmed Stop for what is stuck, heavy or left behind. Reads every 5 seconds only while open.
gates: in-app host only: ThisPhoneScreen shows the row when host.kind == PhoneHostKind.inApp and a reading has processes

elements.label: Process row
elements.effect: Opens the details sheet: what it is, why it is marked, facts, and command, ids, owner and conversation id under Details; Stop {name} when it may be stopped.

elements.label: Stop
elements.effect: Asks 'Stop {name}?', then sends exactly that pid to stopProcesses and says what stopped and why anything did not.
gates: not a server root nor the app; left behind, stuck or heavy (otherwise in the row's menu)

elements.label: Stop all {count} left behind
elements.effect: Asks once, naming each process left behind, then sends exactly those pids.
gates: while something is left behind

notPages.reason: shared helpers and the package job panel (LinuxJobPanel) shown on the hub and Packages; its Stop is listed on the hub page
